storage_agenda.title: Compress bounded VM write overlays with verified migration
storage_agenda.acceptance: Preserve all disk bytes and existing limits; corruption/restart/FUA tests pass; offline forward/reverse conversions verified; independently reviewed guest boot if activated; production/Linux untouched.

storage_agenda.title: Measure current physical and logical storage
storage_agenda.acceptance: Record allocated versus logical bytes, filesystem free space, open files and time; distinguish shared APFS extents from reclaimable bytes.

storage_agenda.title: Review changed-source storage evidence
storage_agenda.acceptance: Revalidate affected acceptance checks against current source hashes; retain historical deployment hashes and mark unresolved evidence stale.

storage_agenda.title: Measure write-overlay growth over several hours
storage_agenda.acceptance: Bounded read-only samples report rows, allocated bytes, WAL bytes and growth rate; no VM restarts or model inference.

storage_agenda.title: Round-trip a consistent real overlay snapshot
storage_agenda.acceptance: SQLite backup of the running overlay converts forward and back with identical logical fingerprints; respect 10 GiB reserve and preserve live source.

storage_agenda.title: Measure compression CPU and disk tradeoffs
storage_agenda.acceptance: Use closed snapshots or small fixtures; report compression ratio, write/flush latency and bounded memory without guest load generation.

storage_agenda.title: Exercise malformed compressed writes
storage_agenda.acceptance: Reject truncation, changed checksum, invalid lengths, trailing payload, unknown codec and decompression expansion; failed writes preserve prior bytes.

storage_agenda.title: Exercise interrupted write and conversion recovery
storage_agenda.acceptance: Fixture-only process interruption proves acknowledged FUA writes persist and incomplete conversions never replace the source.

storage_agenda.title: Verify compressed writes retain logical limits
storage_agenda.acceptance: Compressible input cannot bypass the 2 GiB logical cap; multi-block failures are atomic and base-equivalent writes release rows.

storage_agenda.title: Prove compressed-to-raw rollback offline
storage_agenda.acceptance: Closed snapshot restores using the prior backend with matching disk bytes; document exact helper, config and service restoration order.

storage_agenda.title: Audit managed disk service identity
storage_agenda.acceptance: Config, seed pin, base identity, codec and running service agree; wrong-format reuse is rejected before a guest attaches.

storage_agenda.title: Observe the migrated guest over several hours
storage_agenda.acceptance: After independently verified activation, record fresh relay frames and bounded overlay growth; report gaps and preserve production/Linux PIDs.

storage_agenda.title: Audit WAL and checkpoint storage
storage_agenda.acceptance: Measure WAL growth and current checkpoint behavior; identify readers and explain safe checkpoint conditions without editing live SQLite files.

storage_agenda.title: Measure redundant changed-block retention
storage_agenda.acceptance: Closed snapshot audit counts blocks equal to immutable backing and models reclaimable pages without changing live data.

storage_agenda.title: Measure immutable seed density
storage_agenda.acceptance: Read-only audit reports compressed payload, index/page overhead and raw fallback counts; seed SHA remains unchanged.

storage_agenda.title: Measure shared-base physical allocation
storage_agenda.acceptance: Record original/base clones and link identities; do not count apparent clone sizes as independent reclaimable storage.

storage_agenda.title: Verify preserved original VM disk
storage_agenda.acceptance: Original disk exists, remains closed and matches recorded identity; no deletion or replacement of the rollback original.

storage_agenda.title: Map model manifests to blobs
storage_agenda.acceptance: Each installed manifest and blob is accounted for; shared references and resident models prevent false orphan classification.

storage_agenda.title: Verify the offloaded model backup
storage_agenda.acceptance: Manifest references and every backup blob hash verify from durable operator storage; test metadata restoration in an isolated temporary directory.

storage_agenda.title: Recheck compressed private OCR runtime
storage_agenda.acceptance: Pinned runtime byte inventory, signatures and sandboxed help check pass; record actual allocation without running inference.

storage_agenda.title: Find bounded regenerable cache candidates
storage_agenda.acceptance: Read-only inventory identifies owner, regeneration path, allocated size, last use and open-file checks; exclude guest disks and model data.

storage_agenda.title: Find unused build and maintenance artifacts
storage_agenda.acceptance: Trace launch agents, symlinks, imports and rollback references before classifying artifacts; report only evidence-backed candidates.

storage_agenda.title: Measure logs and retained evidence growth
storage_agenda.acceptance: Report largest growing logs and retention policies; preserve acceptance receipts, private evidence and current service logs.

storage_agenda.title: Prepare exact reviewed reclamation actions
storage_agenda.acceptance: List exact paths, expected physical savings, ownership, references, backup and rollback evidence; no wildcard deletion or automatic approval.

storage_agenda.title: Audit cloud archive references
storage_agenda.acceptance: Read-only check maps receipts and manifests to archive objects and pending multipart uploads; no cloud deletion.

storage_agenda.title: Prepare bounded cloud recovery verification
storage_agenda.acceptance: Estimate download, temporary disk, cache and guest resource needs; retain existing recovery approval/resource gates.

storage_agenda.title: Track disk, memory and swap pressure
storage_agenda.acceptance: Bounded hourly observations identify competing load without stopping other apps or relaxing the existing admission thresholds.

storage_agenda.title: Review storage reserve and growth alerts
storage_agenda.acceptance: Derive warning thresholds from measured growth and existing reserves; report predicted exhaustion without lowering hard safety limits.

storage_agenda.title: Verify hours-long shell supervision
storage_agenda.acceptance: Observe multiple timed ticks, deadline and lock ownership; no duplicate supervisor, unattended worker heartbeat or false completion.

storage_agenda.title: Exercise supervisor outage recovery
storage_agenda.acceptance: Fixture tests retry classified connection failures, preserve completed jobs and refuse integrity-failure retries or gated guest starts.

storage_agenda.title: Document measured storage and recovery procedures
storage_agenda.acceptance: Update existing repository documentation with verified formats, entrypoints, reserves, migration/rollback order and unresolved blockers.

storage_agenda.title: Compare final storage with the baseline
storage_agenda.acceptance: Report measured physical savings, logical sizes, retained backups and open blockers; staged candidates and apparent clone sizes are not savings.
